decks.notes: This Legacy deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by using control elements such as Pithing Needle, Trinisphere, and Chalice of the Void. The goal is to lock down the opponent's resources while leveraging powerful cards like Karn, the Great Creator and The One Ring to dominate the battlefield. Additionally, the deck utilizes efficient mana acceleration with Dark Ritual and Chrome Mox, as well as graveyard hate with Leyline of the Void. The inclusion of cards like Fell the Profane and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional win conditions and value. The deck is designed to control the game and secure victory through strategic plays.

The deck focuses on combining Doomsday with Thassa's Oracle or Jace, Wielder of Mysteries to win the game in a single turn. It utilizes various cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Personal Tutor to set up the combo quickly. Cards like Force of Will and Daze provide protection and disruption against opponents. The deck aims to draw and manipulate cards with Ponder, Brainstorm, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student while controlling the board with Thoughtseize and removal spells. Overall, the deck is built around executing a powerful combo as efficiently as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently mill through the entire deck, putting either Thassa's Oracle or Balustrade Spy into play to win the game immediately. It utilizes a combination of fast mana sources, creature sacrifice outlets, and protection spells to ensure the combo can be executed as quickly as possible. The deck also includes various backup plans and ways to manipulate the graveyard in case the primary combo is disrupted. Overall, the key strategy is to assemble the necessary pieces to win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck utilizes the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. By utilizing artifacts such as Mox Opal, Urza's Saga, and Lotus Petal, as well as card draw spells like Thoughtcast and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while controlling the game with counterspells like Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Soul-Guide Lantern provide additional utility and disruption, allowing the deck to effectively disrupt the opponent's game plan while executing its own win condition.

This deck focuses on maintaining control over the game by leveraging cheap interactive spells like Force of Will and Daze while disrupting the opponent with hand disruption like Thoughtseize. The deck aims to establish tempo by playing threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf while protecting them with counterspells and removal spells. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Fatal Push allow for flexibility in dealing with various threats, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and deck manipulation. The manabase includes Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base and ensure strategic advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to use spells like Show and Tell to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play early in the game. By utilizing cards like Sneak Attack and Omniscience, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with massive creatures and game-changing effects. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its key combo pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies. With a mix of ramp, card draw, and powerful finishers, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to respond.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using cards like Swords to Plowshares, Dress Down, Force of Will, Brainstorm, and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also aims to quickly bring out Phyrexian Dreadnought and use cards like Doorkeeper Thrull and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to support its powerful abilities. The deck focuses on stifling the opponent's options while efficiently drawing and searching for key cards to maintain control of the game.

The deck aims to generate a high storm count to cast Tendrils of Agony for lethal damage. It utilizes cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Dark Ritual to generate mana quickly while using Burning Wish to search for the necessary combo pieces. Thoughtseize and Veil of Summer help protect the combo from disruption, while Echo of Eons and Brainstorm provide card draw and manipulation. Gaea's Will and Song of Creation can provide additional resources to further fuel the storm count. The deck is designed to be fast and resilient, with the potential for explosive wins.

This UWx Control deck aims to control the tempo of the game through counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, while utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Supreme Verdict to deal with threats. The deck also focuses on card advantage and manipulation with cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Murktide Regent adds additional win conditions and disruption to the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to maintain control of the board and hand while setting up for a game-winning play.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Combo - Show and Tell deck is to quickly and efficiently put powerful cards into play using the Show and Tell card. By using cards such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and The One Ring, the player can rapidly overwhelm their opponent with powerful creatures and game-changing artifacts. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect their combo pieces, as well as cards like Cunning Wish to search for specific answers or additional combo pieces when needed. The deck aims to win the game by setting up a powerful board state that the opponent cannot easily overcome.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to efficiently manipulate your library and resources to set up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle. You use cards like Personal Tutor and Doomsday to carefully stack your deck, while also protecting your combo with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes various cantrips and disruption spells to help you find and assemble your combo pieces quickly. It's all about careful planning and execution to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, and then bring them back onto the battlefield with Animate Dead and Reanimate. By utilizing powerful reanimation spells and disruptive cards like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with hard-to-deal-with threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent provide additional flexibility and aggression, making it a potent combo-reanimator archetype in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while establishing a dominant position on the board. Utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to control the opponent's options, along with powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Ponder and Brainstorm, as well as powerful threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Murktide Regent. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating advantage to win the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with powerful creatures such as Griselbrand and then reanimate them onto the battlefield for a strong offense. Cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead allow for quick graveyard manipulation, while cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize provide disruption to your opponent's game plan. By efficiently utilizing these combo pieces, you aim to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and potentially win the game in just a few turns.

The deck revolves around using Nadu, Winged Wisdom in combination with Nomads en-Kor to draw and cycle through the deck quickly, while also using cards like Stock Up and Green Sun's Zenith to find key pieces. This allows the player to set up a powerful combo win condition with cards like Bristly Bill, Spine Sower and Collector Ouphe, while controlling the game with counter spells like Force of Will. The deck also includes some versatile lands like Karakas and Boseiju, Who Endures to deal with opposing threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing Show and Tell to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul onto the battlefield, while using Sneak Attack as an additional way to sneak creatures into play. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to further enhance the combo potential. The deck runs a suite of counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its combo pieces, alongside card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. With efficient mana acceleration from Lotus Petal and City of Traitors, the deck aims to quickly set up its game-winning combo.
